Outside only pale snow and a distant city suggested by a handful of VERY low-contrast misty blue-grey architectural brush masses, no distinct landmark, no high-contrast focal building, no photographic blur/bokeh. The neutral ivory, restrained grey-teal, slate blue and tiny warm textile accents should feel comfortably harmonious like reference 2. Dry indoors, winter only outside and at fireplace. Near-future postmodern functional camp outside a city, roughly a century from now, restrained contemporary-to-future furniture silhouettes. No old wooden rustic furniture, ornaments, symbols, emblems, UI, text, logos, people, weapon racks, neon or sci-fi greebles. Full landscape 16:9 illustration.
